page: City page: B2B lead generation Mumbai (/b2b-lead-generation-mumbai)

items.question: Do we need to be based in Mumbai to work with you?
items.answer: No. We're headquartered in Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), Mumbai, and many of our clients are here, but the entire engagement runs remotely. Strategy calls, sequence approvals and weekly reporting happen over video calls and a shared dashboard, so location has no bearing on how the system is built or managed.

items.question: Do you only work with Mumbai companies?
items.answer: No. Mumbai is where we're based and where a large share of our clients are, but we run outbound systems for B2B companies across India and internationally, 130+ so far. Campaigns for Mumbai buyers use the same process as everywhere else, with lists, copy and timing adapted to your industry.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, and most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. The first two weeks go into ICP mapping, list building, sending domains with warm-up, and copy. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, once messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.

items.question: Are you a lead generation company or a B2B marketing company?
items.answer: Myntmore is an outbound lead generation company, not a full-service B2B marketing company. We run cold email, LinkedIn outreach, account-based marketing and founder personal branding to start sales conversations. We don't run paid ads, SEO or brand design, so pair us with a marketing agency if you need those too.

items.question: Which Mumbai industries do you have the most experience with?
items.answer: BFSI and wealth management, media and entertainment, professional services and B2B SaaS founders are where we've run the most campaigns. Examples include 150+ qualified leads for a wealth management and PMS firm and a ₹72 lakh pipeline for a fintech SaaS company. The system adapts to any B2B ICP.

items.question: What channels do you actually use to generate leads?
items.answer: Primarily cold email and LinkedIn outreach tuned to cut through Mumbai's crowded BFSI and media inboxes, layered with account-based marketing for named target accounts, and AI-assisted signal tracking and personalisation underneath all three. We pick the mix based on where your buyers actually spend their attention.

items.question: How is this different from hiring an in-house SDR?
items.answer: Hiring an in-house SDR in Mumbai means months of recruiting and ramp-up at some of the country's highest salaries and office costs, before they're fully productive. A managed outbound system has multiple channels live within about three weeks, at a fraction of that fully loaded cost, and scales without you managing headcount.

items.question: What do you need from us to get started?
items.answer: A clear picture of your ICP (even a rough one works), access to a domain we can set up for outbound sending, and about an hour of your time for an onboarding call. We handle ICP refinement, list building, sequence writing, and day-to-day campaign management from there.

items.question: Where in Mumbai are you based?
items.answer: Our team works out of BKC (Bandra Kurla Complex), so we can meet Mumbai clients in person when it helps. Campaigns themselves run remotely, and we work with companies across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai and Thane, from Lower Parel and Andheri to Powai.

items.question: How do I choose a lead generation agency in Mumbai?
items.answer: Ask four things: whether they have run campaigns in your industry, how they build and verify their lists, what they report each week (meetings and conversations, not just emails sent), and whether you can leave without a long contract. Be wary of an agency that promises a fixed number of leads before seeing your ICP.

items.question: Do you offer appointment setting for Mumbai companies?
items.answer: Yes. Appointment setting is part of every engagement: we handle the replies and book qualified meetings straight into your calendar, so your sales team only joins calls with buyers who have agreed to talk. Each meeting comes with notes on the prospect and what they asked about.
